visual_argument: One West zone site at last light, drawn to illustrate: the primer steel is up, the power is staged as copper bars at one bar per gigawatt and the cable trench is grated for the answered share of its length, while the cooling pads beside the hall sit poured, bolted and empty inside an ember line that means left blank
build_risk: Frame 6 stages the primer frame, four empty pads with anchor bolts and a worker on the nearest pad as one subject from 9 m up, so the ember line and the worker must read at 432 px while the lit caliche stays out of the mid tones. It drew a trench beside the pads until the panel showed the pads read as a cooling blank larger than the whole unanswered share, so the pads are a place and never a number.
distinct_from_recent: No. 75 was a parked lot of stand-in cars with a gold stripe; this has no vehicles and no stripe, and its count frame is cable reels on caliche. No. 74 was tidal flats, survey laths and precast blocks; this is a graded caliche upland with primer steel and poured pads. No. 73 was compute trays under a flood in a hall; this is outdoors at last light with no electronics. No. 60 was the same questionnaire as a cast iron plate with a bore and plug per facility; here nothing is filled per respondent, the answered share is one continuous grated length and the blank is a poured pad with nothing on it.
